label: Engineering RFC
prompt: An RFC deck proposing to move our job queue from Redis to Postgres. Include trade-offs table and migration timeline.
md:
---
title: RFC — Postgres job queue
bg: grid
font: plex
transition: fade
---
^ RFC 0051
# Move jobs from Redis to Postgres
One fewer system to run.
---
# Why now
- Redis is our only non-Postgres datastore
- Two job losses this quarter on failover
- SKIP LOCKED makes Postgres queues fast enough
> [!WARNING] Throughput ceiling is ~5k jobs/s on current hardware.
---
# Trade-offs
| | Redis | Postgres |
|---|---|---|
| Durability | Best-effort | **Transactional** |
| Throughput | 50k/s | 5k/s |
| Ops cost | Extra cluster | **None** |
---
# The claim query
```sql claim.sql {3}
UPDATE jobs SET state = 'running'
WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE state = 'queued'
  ORDER BY run_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1)
RETURNING *;
```
---
# Migration
:::timeline style=h
- Wk 1 | Dual-write
- Wk 2 | Shadow reads
- Wk 3 | Cut over
- Wk 4 | Remove Redis?
:::
